sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's mandatory biodiesel (B35/B40) and geothermal expansion programs create a durable domestic demand floor for local renewable producers, insulating them from global capital-cost shocks.

Vertical integration into downstream green products (ammonia, EV batteries) is becoming the key margin differentiator for Indonesian players, as raw commodity exports face pricing pressure.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesian renewables names with domestic revenue exposure (TOBA, TPIA) and avoid US-listed climate-tech laggards; the ID/US divergence signals local policy tailwinds are outpacing global rate-driven weakness. Add TOBA on strength for geothermal scale-up, hold TPIA for green ammonia optionality, and trim PLUG/ARKO into any bounce as US demand remains soft.

Structural shift toward food-away-from-home (NASI, CARS) and tech-enabled retail (NANO, BTEK) is accelerating, supported by rising urban middle-class spending and digital adoption.
sectors.ai: Buy selective small-cap FMCG names showing volume-driven re-rating (AGAR, BTEK, NAYZ) while large caps lag; US strength (+1.00%) supports export-linked consumer plays. Rotate into food-service and specialty retail sub-sectors with earnings momentum, avoid broad index exposure. Target 3-6 week horizon, set tight stops at 5% below entry given normal signal volatility.
